sections.heading: Overview
bullets: No enrage-driven damage check until 8 minutes — this fight is about not getting displaced into a bad spot or caught by the group-wide spike.

sections.heading: Displacement (red circles)
bullets: 3 red circles spawn around the arena — <mark>Displacement</mark> teleports anyone standing in one to a random spot in the arena when it detonates, plus damage. Dangerous mainly because it can combine with a knockback from something else. Dodge out if you can, or use a mobility skill to escape and reposition back to the squad immediately.

sections.heading: Spatial Manipulation (green circles)
bullets: Green circles appear with gold orbs above them — each needs a minimum number of players matching its orb count to activate. Being outside an active <mark>Spatial Manipulation</mark> circle when it detonates means heavy damage, 25 stacks of Unseen Burden, and a stun. Standing in one when it pops clears 25 Unseen Burden stacks instead.
Circles that follow Energy Surge or Orbital Sweep don't have a player-count requirement.

sections.heading: Energy Surge & Gravity Wave
bullets: <mark>Energy Surge</mark>: Cairn surges forward across the platform, damaging and knocking back anyone in his path — watch the directional arrows at his feet and dodge or sidestep. He always follows this with Spatial Manipulation, so the sequence is predictable.

<mark>Gravity Wave</mark> (from 25% health, after <mark>Orbital Sweep</mark>): a cascading wave of energy pushes everyone back — staying stacked close to Cairn keeps you safe from it, so don't spread out during this one.

sections.heading: Targeting & Enrage
bullets: Cairn targets the furthest player for attacks like <mark>Shared Agony</mark> and <mark>Meteor Swarm</mark> — plan positioning accordingly. He also pulses <mark>Cosmic Aura</mark>, a passive damage tick to everyone fighting him.
8:00 enrage — past this point Unseen Burden stacks can no longer be cleansed, so a slow group snowballs fast.

cmSections.heading: What's different in Challenge Mote
bullets: No health increase — this is a mechanics check, not a bigger damage race.

You gain a buff that counts down from 10 seconds — if you don't manually use Celestial Dash before it runs out, you're forced to dash in whatever direction you're currently facing. Keep it on near-permanent cooldown for the whole fight.

At 99 stacks of Unseen Burden, you're immobilized and locked out of every skill except Celestial Dash until you stand in a green circle during Spatial Manipulation — you can no longer invuln through the green circle requirement like in Normal.
